newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-No trades in SFE wheat futures market.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-No trades in SFE wheat futures market.

text.p: Sydney Futures Exchange wheat futures failed to trade on Thursday as the market went into "wait and see" mode, dealers said.
"The market is waiting to see what happens to the U.S. spring wheat crop in the next few weeks," Garry Booth of Ord Minnett Jardine Fleming Futures said.
Besides, many players were at this week's Australian Bureau of Agricultural and Resource Economics (ABARE) Outlook conference in Canberra, he said.
He said the outlook for Australian wheat prices looked good, based on the Australian Wheat Board's full shipping programme and the recent drop in the Australian dollar.
He also cited the bullish U.S. Consensus Report indicating wheat was heavily oversold as another optimistic factor for wheat prices.
